associations.rationale: The formal type directly states or defines the item: A parameterized auxiliary object associated with a ring and one of its modules.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The type attached to a given auxiliary object.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The additive commutative group structure provided on the attached type.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: An opaque property asserted for the attached type over the ambient ring.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The scalar action of the ambient ring on the attached type.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The attached type is a projective module over the ambient ring.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The linear map from the attached type to the ambient module.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: If a submodule together with the map kernel spans the attached type, then the submodule is all of it.
The formal type provides an exact-module supporting component: The associated linear map reaches every element of the ambient module.
